package task

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
)

// ListTasksByLesson returns tasks for a lesson.
type ListTasksByLesson struct {
	Tasks repository.TaskRepository
}

// Handle fetches all tasks for the given lesson.
func (uc ListTasksByLesson) Handle(ctx context.Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.Task, error) {
	return uc.Tasks.ListByLesson(ctx, lessonID)
}

// HandleWithFields fetches tasks with specified fields only.
func (uc ListTasksByLesson) HandleWithFields(ctx context.Context, lessonID string, f queryfields.Set, filters filters.TaskFilters, sort *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	// Apply lessonID from URL if not set in filters
	if filters.LessonID == nil {
		filters.LessonID = &lessonID
	}

	return uc.Tasks.ListByLessonFields(ctx, lessonID, f, filters, sort)
}
